Maria G.: Quick heads-up — ran the customer eval suite (structured-output + open-ended QA) against the 4-bit quantized build and seeing clear quality regressions and more hallucinations. attaching logs in the thread :frowning:
Lee H.: which 4-bit kernel and calibration mode did you use?
Maria G.: q4_fused_kv (new fused KV path), per-channel symmetric, calibration using 512-sample min-max from a 5k token corpus (same as our default calib script). sequence length 2k.
Raj P.: any perf traces? could be KV cache alignment or weird packing in the fused kernel.
Maria G.: yes — profiler shows a spike at kv_cache_write for long contexts and lots of small memcpy calls. latency per-token up ~18% on some traces.
Emily Z.: eval numbers: BLEU down 4.2, ROUGE-L down 3.1, hallucination rate (QA) +12 percentage points absolute. Structured-output schema failures ~+9% (broken JSON or missing fields).
perf-bot: nightly-regression: structured-output delta = +9.0% failures, threshold 5.0% — alert created (#reg-2026-03-15-17)
Lee H.: hmm. two hypotheses: (A) calibration quantization ranges are clipping important activation dynamics (esp. softmax logits for structured tokens), (B) fused KV path quantization/rounding causes drift in attention weights with long KV reuse.
Raj P.: I ran a quick repro locally — when I force the kernel selector to fallback to the generic q4_reference kernel the hallucination delta disappears (back to within noise). so the issue looks specific to fused kernel implementation interacting with quantization ranges.
Maria G.: good catch. can you paste the minimal repro command?
Raj P.: sure:
```
./tools/run_eval.sh --model redwood/llama-7b --quant q4_fused_kv --calib-samples 512 --dataset customer_eval --seq 2048
# fallback test:
./tools/run_eval.sh --model redwood/llama-7b --quant q4_reference --calib-samples 512 --dataset customer_eval --seq 2048
```
Emily Z.: also tried per-layer calibration rather than global min-max and that reduced structured failures by ~60% vs global min-max. so calibration strategy matters.
Lee H.: actionable items: (1) Raj + Maria to bisect fused kernel changes vs reference implementation and add more unit tests around KV quantized accumulators; (2) perf/infra to add a nightly eval that runs fused vs reference on the structured-output suite; (3) short-term workaround: pin runtime to q4_reference for customers with strict structured output requirements.
Maria G.: opened GH issue: redwood/runtime#4321 with repro and logs. tagging @Raj and @Lee as assignees.
perf-bot: issue redwood/runtime#4321 created by Maria G. — link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/issues/4321
Raj P.: I'll start a git bisect tomorrow. initial suspicion: int-to-float conversion path in fused kernel has an extra floor/round that biases small attention scores.
Lee H.: also add a calibration-mode flag (per-layer/global/minmax/percentile) to the kernel API so we can A/B without rebuilding.
Emily Z.: for triage notes: priority P1 for customer-repro, severity high for structured-output pipelines. QA will run extended eval after the bisect and when a patch lands.
Maria G.: thanks all. adding the short checklist here: 1) reproduce on dedicated infra, 2) confirm regression goes away with q4_reference, 3) bisect fused kernel, 4) try per-layer calibration, 5) add unit/integration tests, 6) provide opt-out flag for customers. assigning approximate ETA: 48-72h for initial bisect.
Lee H.: ACK. @perf-bot please schedule a fresh nightly comparing q4_fused_kv vs q4_reference across structured-output harness.
perf-bot: scheduled nightly job: q4_fused_kv_vs_reference on eng-runtime-nodes. first run in 2h.
Maria G.: adding note — if bisect points to quant math, test INT8 fallback too. if it's KV packing, we may need alignment-padding fix in fused kernel.
Raj P.: will report back with bisect commit range + perf traces.
Emily Z.: I'll prep a reduced prompt set to speed CI runs (100 examples) so we can iterate faster.
Maria G.: thanks — will update the GH issue and slack thread as we make progress :thumbsup:
